topic: HATCH and MPOLYGON inactive gradient-stop writer refusal and retry

relevant_fields.450: Gradient fill flag; 0 denotes solid fill
relevant_fields.453: Number of colors in the gradient definition

finding: When gradient fill is disabled, a nonempty gradient color-stop list has no documented DXF carrier. Reject the payload before sticky entity preflight so the writer can be corrected and reused.

behavior: writeHatch and writeMPolygon validate payload representability before preflightEntity can latch a writer error
In ASCII and Binary modes, invalid solid-fill records leave the destination empty
Clearing the inactive gradient stops permits same-writer retry and a following sentinel record, checking that refusal did not corrupt writer state

supports: Generated ASCII and Binary atomic refusal for solid-fill HATCH and MPOLYGON payloads carrying gradient stops
Same-writer corrected retry after removing the unrepresentable stops
does_not_support: HATCH or MPOLYGON fill semantic equivalence
